title: Category
description: JSON Schema for a category — a tuple (Ob, Hom, compose, id) of an object-collection, a morphism-collection, a composition operation, and an identity assignment (Eilenberg & Mac Lane 1945; Mac Lane 1971 Ch. I §1; Awodey 2010 §1.2). The schema captures the structural data: the objects array and the morphisms array. The category axioms — composition closure (codomain of f equals domain of g for any composite g∘f stored), associativity ((h∘g)∘f = h∘(g∘f)), and identity laws (id_A ∘ f = f and g ∘ id_B = g) — are not captured here; they are checked by category-axiom transformers operating over instances.

objects.description: The object-collection Ob(C). Each element is an object instance with at least a name; objects in the collection are distinct (uniqueItems).

morphisms.description: The morphism-collection. Each element is a transformer instance with name, domain, and codomain. Identity morphisms id_A for each object A are stored as elements with domain = codomain = A's name. Composition closure (the array contains every composite of pairs whose codomain-domain match) is a category-axiom law checked by the category-closure transformer.
